name: untapped-site-audit
description: A guided live-site audit (indexed, seen, buyer phrases, on-page targeting, visitors, buyers) plus free on-page checks across a sitemap: titles, H1s, canonicals, noindex, schema, thin pages, duplicates.

interface.shortDescription: Audit a site in the order that finds the bottleneck
interface.longDescription: Walks your agent through a website audit in the order that finds the real bottleneck, so it never tunes titles on pages Google hasn't indexed. Includes free tools that read every page in a sitemap and flag missing or duplicate titles, H1s and descriptions, wrong canonicals, noindex pages in the sitemap, redirects, robots.txt blocks, broken schema and thin pages. Works with Untapped Index Watch, Search Console and SERP when installed.
defaultPrompt: Audit example.com and tell me what's holding it back
Check every page in my sitemap for title and H1 problems
Why isn't my website bringing in customers?
